blocks.meta_description: Public read-only Timeblock block ledger for internal point history across member, business, and project wallet operations.
blocks.title: Timeblock internal point block history
blocks.intro: Read-only block records for internal point activity across Timeblock members, business wallets, and project customer wallets. Sensitive identifiers are masked; records are for platform audit history only.
blocks.empty: No block records match this filter.
member.wallet.transfer.title: Transfer internal points
member.wallet.transfer.body: Send internal points to another verified Timeblock member. The transfer creates debit and credit block records in the public ledger.
phase9.business_wallet.transfer_body: Send internal points to another Timeblock business account by business code, owner email, or exact company name.
phase9.message.business_points_transferr: Business internal points transfer has been written to the ledger.
